desc:
After resigning from your job at a hotel, you decide to start a new career at Cahaya Pratama Hospital as a night shift worker. What seemed like an ordinary job quickly turns into a terrifying nightmare.

Your shift runs from 8:00 PM to 5:00 AM, where you'll complete 28+ unique tasks throughout the hospital. From taking care of patients and fixing electrical problems to cleaning up mysterious incidents, every task brings you deeper into the darkness.

But you're not alone...

Will you survive the night and finish your shift, or become the hospital's next victim?

🩺 Features:
• 🌙 Night Shift (8:00 PM – 5:00 AM)
• 📋 28+ Unique Tasks
• 👥 Multiplayer Co-op
• 🔄 Rejoin & Continue Your Shift
• 💡 Adjustable Brightness
• 😱 Random Horror Events & Jumpscares
• 🔦 Immersive Hospital Environment
• 🎧 Atmospheric Sound Design
• 💀 Multiple Scares Await

Developed by: r4faachp
